observations: body: the line numbers 5 to 30 stand in the right margin and the locators «p. 90.» (L3) and «p. 91.» (L20) in the left margin.
body L1, L2: the words from «e gradibus» to «efficiunt» are italic (the end of the interpolation of p. 59, note 6).
body L19: a low point stands after the comma that follows «EG»; it is not transcribed.
notes_left L10: the sign after the 2 is the small raised ring of the degrees, not the raised p of the parts that the text has («2 partes» is meant).
notes_right L5: the theta of «μέγεϑος» is printed in its open form.
notes_right L7: the denominator of the fraction is printed blotted; it is read as 2 by its flat foot.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
